note: MoProbe-H: 414 first frames from the Something-Something v2 validation split. H = first dimension of each frame (camera = camera / direction-only frame); dims = all dimensions; conds = available prompt conditions (ex = true prompt, cf = opposite prompt, nx / nt = empty prompt, rex / rcf = new-role true / opposite prompt); scored = frames of the five scored dimensions; role2 = frames that carry rex / rcf rows; f1_frames = frames with Inertia records in the five scored dimensions; f1_diag_frames = role / role2 diagnostic frames; items_dir = MoProbe item folder of the frame (relative to MOPROBE_ROOT). Prompts per condition: moprobe_h_rows.jsonl.
